facts.text: When it was founded in 1915, Marywood was the first college for women in Northeastern Pennsylvania and the first Catholic college for women in the state.

sources.title: History - Marywood University
sources.quote: When it was founded in 1915, Marywood was the first college for women in Northeastern Pennsylvania and the first Catholic college for women in the state.

facts.text: Marywood's Core Curriculum helps students develop intentional learning strategies through the use of metacognition across all Core courses.

sources.title: Core Curriculum - Marywood University
sources.quote: The Core Curriculum helps students develop intentional learning strategies through the use of metacognition–thinking about and reflecting on their own learning, skills, and processes—to identify areas of strength and struggle.
